notes: Your highlights & notes stay yours if you downgrade

items.question: Is the free plan really free?
items.answer: Yes. Reading, highlights, notes and focus mode are free forever, with no page limits and no ads. Pro only unlocks the AI companion and unlimited sync.

items.question: Do my PDFs leave my device?
items.answer: Documents stay on your device. Only the passages you ask about are sent for AI processing, and they're never used for training.

items.question: What happens if I downgrade?
items.answer: Everything you made stays readable — AI summaries, review cards, all your notes. You just can't generate new ones until you're back on Pro.

items.question: Is there a student discount?
items.answer: Students and educators with an academic email get 40% off Pro — that's $2.99 a month billed annually.
